mechanism: Cimetidine inhibits CYP450 metabolism (particularly CYP1A2 and CYP3A4) and may increase methimazole levels; both drugs can rarely cause agranulocytosis, increasing hematologic risk.
action: Monitor complete blood counts regularly and watch for signs of agranulocytosis; consider alternative H2-blocker (famotidine) or proton pump inhibitor if possible.
